files.received_by: tools/xeng.mjs init generates a project-level PR template
files.reason: Target projects receive a template; this repository itself does not carry the upstream template body. G-01 stays deferred at repository level.

files.received_by: src/handoff.mjs stop conditions; src/evidence.mjs bounded evidence states
files.reason: Bounded loop semantics exist as stop conditions and evidence gates, but the upstream adoption narrative was not copied.
Method-adoption record is cross-repo governance knowledge. It should be owned by AI-Native-Work-Learning-OS or recorded here as a candidate, not copied into the public runtime.
Workbench has a planning stage and draft tickets, but not the updated template fields. G-03 is downgraded from EQUIVALENT_REPLACEMENT to PARTIAL_REPLACEMENT.
Starter tickets already carry outcome, negative case, blocked_by, stage, base SHA, agent and permission, but not the full upstream template. No template body copied.
Portfolio README text; no engineering runtime behaviour.

gaps_reassessment.reason: xeng init generates a PR template for target projects, but this repository has no committed .github/pull_request_template.md and generic git rules remain project-local.
Handoff permissions, stop conditions and agent destinations still cover the runtime need; no new upstream delta contradicts it.

gaps_reassessment.item: postmortem / pull-request / review / external-demand and tracer-ticket templates
gaps_reassessment.reason: The old claim was too strong. Upstream PR #5 added a tracer-ticket template and changed the implementation-plan template; Workbench only has a draft ticket generator. Keep as an open improvement candidate, not a claimed equivalent.
Profile obligations plus xeng audit still cover the semantics; the delta did not add new checklists.
Organisation inventory remains outside the engineering runtime.

conclusion: Three upstream commits appeared after the frozen snapshot. None is a runtime dependency. Two templates and one adoption record are not absorbed; G-03 is corrected from equivalent replacement to partial replacement. No Workbench or Learning OS change is authorised by this audit alone.
